Spot the Difference Rules

Find every place where the two pictures differ.

The rules

The pictures
Two pictures made of simple black-and-white drawings: a house, a tree, a cat, a car and more. Each drawing stands in an area of its own, so two differences are never in the same place.
What can differ
A drawing is missing in one picture, has another pattern (black, white, stripes or dots), is mirrored or is moved a little.
Tapping
Tap a difference in either picture: it gets a thick circle in both. A tap where there is no difference only says so - no penalty, no time limit. The Hint button frames an area that still holds a difference.
Levels
Easy: 3 differences. Medium: 5. Hard: 7, in pictures with more drawings. Every game is a new pair of pictures.
Picture search
In the mode "Picture search" there is one large picture of a room and, above it, small pictures of 5, 7 or 10 things to find. Choose the room next to the level - kitchen, living room, children's room, attic, terrace, garden, dining room, office, hall, bathroom, cellar or bedroom - or let chance pick one. Each room is drawn in plain lines and holds things that belong there, for example a chest, a spinning wheel and a lantern in the attic or a hole punch, a binder and a globe in the office; the animals and things from "Who Took the Cake?" turn up too. Each thing to find is in the large picture exactly once, with the same pattern and the same direction; other drawings may look similar. Tap a thing in the large picture: it is circled there and crossed out above. Easy: 5 things in a sparse picture. Medium: 7. Hard: 10 in a dense picture with many look-alikes. No words are needed.

Example

Two small pictures: the sun is white on the left and black on the right - that is a difference, and it is circled in both.
